 Joe Rindl, Charlotte Coates, Emma Smith & Gary Rose
 Most recent Most popular 'No Chelsea defenders step up' published at 15:31 GMT 15:31 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-1 Leeds 
 Nedum Onuoha 
Former Man City defender on Final Score 
 I think it's a good ball from Dominic Calvert-Lewin but Noah Okafor has got three players in front of him. None of them step up. 
 He goes across onto his left side, you want to make it predictable for the goalkeeper. But it goes through the legs of Levi Colwill, and the keeper can't set himself. 
 32 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Leeds are back on level terms' published at 15:31 GMT 15:31 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-1 Leeds 
 Rob Green 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Stamford Bridge 
 From nothing, Leeds are back on level terms.
 Noah Okafor's strike is direct and into the corner.
 That's some response to a brilliant goal.
 90 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Coventry 2-1 Crystal Palace published at 15:30 GMT 15:30 GMT 
 Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (30 mins) 
 Fine finish!
 More great work from ex-Huddersfield man Jack Rudoni as some neat footwork sees him away down the left. He then lifts a cross to Tatsuhiro Sakamoto on the edge of the box, who takes a touch and the sends a beautiful strike into the roof of the net.
 381 201 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:30 GMT 15:30 GMT 
 Tottenham 1-0 Ipswich 
 Almost 2-0 Tottenham! 
 Winger Mohammed Kudus is so, so unlucky as his free-kick from close range hits the inside of the post but doesn't drop in.
 94 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:29 GMT 15:29 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Just the one shot on target in this opening half an hour. Fair to say it's not been a thriller. 
 43 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:29 GMT 15:29 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Spend over £200 million, and it's the 18 year old who knows where the net is! Spurs need to trust their young players more.
 Tattz, Harborne 
 251 54 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:29 GMT 15:29 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Nottingham Forest 
 Forest have not provided much of a response to going behind.
 If results go against them, they could end this weekend in the relegation zone.
 28 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Chelsea 1-1 Leeds published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Noah Okafor (28 mins) 
 Swift response!
 Noah Okafor does really well as he has three Chelsea players on him as the ball is worked to him on the edge of the box. He takes a few steps forward and manages to squeeze a low effort into the far corner.
 Chelsea's lead lasted all of three minutes.
 1392 462 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The game needed some quality' published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-0 Leeds 
 Nedum Onuoha 
Former Man City defender on Final Score 
 That's from the edge of the box from Emmanuel Emegha, right into the side netting. I think the game was crying out for some quality. 
 87 130 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'What a strike' published at 15:27 GMT 15:27 GMT 
 Chelsea 1-0 Leeds 
 Rob Green 
Former England goalkeeper on BBC Radio 5 Live at Stamford Bridge 
 What a strike from the young man Emmanuel Emegha, he welcomes himself to the Premier League.
 Boy does he have a go.
 It catches James Trafford out, it catches everybody out.
 124 158 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:26 GMT 15:26 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Here come Sunderland as Noah Sadiki slips it right to Wilson Isidor but Villa have enough men in the way and the effort is charged down. 
 86 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Chelsea 1-0 Leeds published at 15:25 GMT 15:25 GMT 
 Emmanuel Emegha (25 mins) 
 First Premier League start = first Chelsea goal for Emmanuel Emegha! 
 It is a really good strike by the forward as Morgan Rogers feeds the ball through to him and Emegha drives in at James Trafford's near post.
 810 876 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:24 GMT 15:24 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Dominic Calvert-Lewin gets in-between Levi Colwill and Wesley Fofana to meet a cross, but his header is straight at Emi Martinez. 
 133 59 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 15:23 GMT 15:23 GMT 
 Coventry 1-1 Crystal Palace 
 Frustration for Coventry fans as they think their side should have a penalty.
 Taiwo Awoniyi is down on the floor as Jack Rudoni's free-kick goes into the box, but the whistle goes for a foul by Awoniyi on Axel Disasi.
 119 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Sunderland fail to clear the Villa free-kick at the first time of asking as Luke O'Nien switches off but a team-mate comes to his rescue to hammer it away. 
 78 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 15:22 GMT 15:22 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Chelsea are going to have to make a change here. Moises Caicedo is down on the pitch for the second time in this game and cannot continue. He is replaced by Jordan Henderson.
 91 124 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Evanilson is on fire' published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Nottingham Forest 
 Steph Houghton 
Former England defender on Final Score 
 Fantastic finish, Evanilson's in red hot form. Forest have been wary of him, it's a great touch from James Hill and he fires it into the rough of the net. He's on fire. 
 142 70 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 GMT 15:21 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Nottingham Forest 
 Evanilson scored six goals in his first 44 Premier League matches.
 He now has six in his last six league games.
 102 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 Johan Manzambi drives up the pitch and decides to have a go instead of finding Nicolas Jackson. 
 Decent enough save from Robin Roefs. 
 157 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 15:19 GMT 15:19 GMT 
 Chelsea 0-0 Leeds 
 Leeds go so close to taking the lead as Dominic Calvert-Lewin slams an effort against the woodwork, with Emi Martinez beaten.
